Add `specs/mngr-start-slowness-investigation.md`: a measured investigation of why `mngr start` on imbue_cloud hosts is slow or hangs. Documents the per-step timing of a healthy start (~13-16s, dominated by ~25-30 sequential SSH round trips), confirms/refutes the prior findings (the unbounded cooperative-lock wait, the adoption-verify cost, the minds-side output discard), and identifies the previously-missed mechanisms: no client-side SSH liveness bounds anywhere in mngr (unbounded per-command reads on a wedged transport), and the container sshd running with ClientAliveInterval 0 so dead-path lock holders persist for ~2h11m. Proposes mechanism-level fixes (transport keepalives and default exec timeouts, container sshd ClientAlive hardening, lock-holder diagnosability, subprocess output capture in minds) with no unattended-mode timeout inside `mngr start`.
